revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Asset name: achievement_medal_travel_tier_006
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the sixth and highest travel tier, global traveler feeling, ornate but clean.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal; uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular cream paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, delicate pencil outline and watercolor texture. Center elements: small watercolor globe, sturdy travel suitcase, compass, curled route ribbon, tiny airplane silhouette as a simple decorative shape, passport-like booklet with no marks or text. No people, no animals.
Style/medium: cozy TripPet watercolor scrapbook collectible, hand-painted, low-saturation but high contrast, delicate pencil linework, polished mobile game asset.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, readable in a small UI; objects should be clear and darker than the base.
Color palette: ivory base, dusty blue globe, ochre suitcase, muted sage land shapes, warm gold compass, tiny coral dots. Avoid pure #00ff00 in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
